$comment: FND-04 deliverable 3 / acceptance item 3. PRD 34 preamble: "The examples below are normative
payload shapes; property names and enum meanings cannot drift from them without PRD/API change
This fixture is what turns "cannot drift" from a human read into an assertion.
test/openapi/prd-34-examples.test.ts uses it to (1) re-extract the fenced ```json block at
`heading` + `blockIndex` from docs/PRD.md and deep-equal it against the example file,
(2) compile `schemaRef` out of schemas/openapi/openapi.yaml with Ajv 2020 and validate the
example against it, and (3) assert the file is wired into the document as an `externalValue`.
The deep-equal is on the PARSED JSON, so whitespace and key order are free but a renamed, added
or dropped property fails — which is exactly the drift PRD 34 forbids. A heading or block index
that does not resolve is a hard failure, never a skip: a skipped example discharges nothing.
docs/PRD.md is frozen (breakdown plan section 4) and read-only here.
